wikipedia.title: 弱弱老师
wikipedia.text:
《弱弱老师》（日语：よわよわ先生）是由福地神绪创作的日本漫画。自2022年第51期（11月16日发行）起在《周刊少年Magazine》（讲谈社）连载。


故事
新学年开始担任阿比仓章人级任导师的鶸村日和，是今年春天刚从大学毕业的新手老师。她第一天就突然额头流血地在教室露面，上课时用学生听不到的声音低声嘟囔着什么，随身携带的笔记本上贴满了不知写些什么的便签纸，她的这些怪异举动让她被学生们称为“咒恨老师”（こわこわ先生）并敬而远之。
几天后，当阿比仓往放学后空荡荡的教室里看时，他发现日和正在一个人努力排练她的课。日和因严重虚弱的体质和害羞的性格而被学生们误解，在了解日和的真实本性后，阿比仓产生了强烈的保护她的愿望，并自愿担任班长，为了支持这位不断失败的“弱弱老师”（よわよわ先生）而努力奋斗。


登场角色
阿比仓章人（阿比仓 章人（あびくら あきひと），Abikura Akihito，声：波多野翔）
本作的主要人物。日和高中二年级的学生。日和本来就不是特别引人注目，本想平静地度过高中生活，但他无法释怀成为班主任的日和不断被其他同学误解，于是他自告奋勇当班代表，成为了班长，开始帮忙排练。他经常遇到涉及日和的幸运事件，每次都受到瑞希的蔑视。在九栗香夜组织的一次拍摄集训中，章人向瑞希坦白了搬家的真相，两人和好如初。
鶸村日和（鶸村 ひより（ひわむら ひより），Hiwamura Hiyori，声：高野麻里佳）
今年春天从大学毕业的新手老师，成为了章人的班主任，她教的科目是英语。
她长得漂亮，胸部大，皮肤很容易晒黑，但除了体质严重虚弱外，她还极度自卑、害羞，导致学生误会她发脾气就会被骂。但透过章人、瑞希、祐树、香夜等人的努力之下，她已经可以与学生们建立良性的师生关系，并在学校文化祭上与他们正常互动。
她强烈渴望成为学生可以信赖的老师，放学后她会在空荡荡的教室里摆毛绒玩具，并排练自己怎么上课。
因为不喜欢早上，也没有信心按时去学校，所以在上司的推荐下，搬到了离高中附近的一套公寓，但她搬进的房间就位在章人的隔壁。
每当她和章人互动时，总是会发生一些幸运事件，随着两人关系的加深，她不知不觉地被章人吸引，当他与其他女性亲近时，她会感到嫉妒，甚至到了想要占有他的地步。
椋林瑞希（椋林 瑞希（むくばやし みずき），Mukubayashi Mizuki，声：伊驹百合绘）
和章人同班的女学生。胸部丰满，但不如日和那么大。虽然章人是同一所小学，但关系并不是特别亲密（两人从小就是朋友，后来渐渐疏远，直到章人转学到自己就读的高中才重逢）。她是个开朗的人，拥有超高中生的运动能力和高度的社交能力，被日和羡慕地视为与她相反的“强势女孩”。她遇见章人陪日和正在排练的场景，并要求日和更换班长，但两人最后一起担任班委。
章人搬家时写了一封信放在瑞希的学校的书桌抽屉里，但她是个经常丢东西的女生，所以没有注意到这封信，以为章人搬家时没有告诉她。因为这件事，瑞希对她曾经视为朋友的章人心生怨恨，高中重逢后也对他很冷淡。然而，在九栗香夜组织的一次拍摄集训中，章人向她坦白了搬家的真相，两人和好如初。她也逐渐开始将章人视为潜在的恋爱对象。
雪下祐树（雪下 祐树（ゆきした ゆうき），Yukishita Yūki，声：筿原侑）
章人的同学。身材娇小，她的第一人称是“俺”。从新学期开始就没来学校上过课，日和每天都会亲自将笔记送到她家，章人陪同日和家访时，被第一次见面的章人误认为是男孩，但实际上是一名女学生。虽然不想上学但对关心自己经常到她家来的日和抱有好感，只要一有机会就想揉她的巨乳。为了看色色的日和而决定来学校。
九栗香夜（九栗 香夜（くぐり かや），Kuguri Kaya，声：夏吉优子）
章人他们所在学校的三年级学生。真实身份是最近在社交媒体上引起热议的摄影师“KuguriN”，上传的照片很有氛围感。
被日和身上散发的性感气息深深吸引因此恳求她成为她的拍摄对象，她还认为只有和章人在一起才能激发她性感的一面，于是招募了两人担任她计划成立的摄影社的顾问和社员，随着瑞希和祐树的加入，摄影社终于找到足够的社员能够正式成立。
阿比仓朱美（阿比仓 朱美（あびくら あけみ），Abikura Akemi，声：中原麻衣）
章人的姐姐。一名29岁的护理师，喜欢宠爱比她小12岁的弟弟，因此被大家称为“温柔的姐姐”。正当因弟弟开始独立而感到孤独时，日和搬进了隔壁的公寓房间，心中涌起的保护弟弟的渴望也随之而来。
柄永英里佳（柄永 英里佳（えなが えりか），Enaga Erika，声：）
章人他们所在学校的二年一班的学生。她说话口气像是大小姐。
风纪委员，以严厉打击违规行为和一旦盯上某人就锲而不舍而闻名，有传言说在一年级的时候就因为新闻社充斥着流言蜚语和捏造事实而强行解散了该社团。然而她认可了摄影社过度激烈的角色扮演称其为“如果是为了艺术那就是合法的活动”，因此被认为是风纪委员中较为宽容的成员。
鹤卷月子（鹤巻 月子（つるまき つきこ），Tsurumaki Sukiko，声：下屋则子）
她是追寻着心动的保健教师。工作中是丁字裤派。阿比仓朱美的大学学妹。

jawiki.title: よわよわ先生
jawiki.text:
『よわよわ先生』（よわよわせんせい）は、福地カミオによる日本の漫画。『週刊少年マガジン』（講談社）にて、2022年51号（11月16日発売）から連載中。
メディアミックスとして、2026年4月から6月までテレビアニメが放送された。


ストーリー
新年度から阿比倉章人のクラス担任になった鶸村ひよりはこの春に大学を卒業したばかりの新米教師。初日でいきなり額から血を流して教室に顔を出し、授業では生徒に聞き取れないような小声でボソボソとつぶやき、いつも持参するノートには何かを書き込んだ付箋がビッシリと貼り付けられている得体の知れなさから「こわこわ先生」と呼ばれて敬遠されるようになってしまう。
数日後に章人が放課後に誰もいないはずの教室を覗くと、そこではひよりが1人で懸命に授業のリハーサルをする姿があった。重度の虚弱体質と引っ込み思案な性格が災いし、生徒に誤解されていたひよりの本来の姿を知った章人は庇護欲を掻き立てられる余りクラス委員に志願し、失敗続きの「よわよわ先生」をサポートしようと奮闘する。


登場人物
声の項はテレビアニメ版の声優を示す。

鶸村 ひより（ひわむら ひより）
声 - 高野麻里佳
本作の主人公。この春に大学を卒業して章人たちのクラス担任になった新米教師で、担当科目は英語。22歳。
美人でB98（Iカップ）の巨乳だが、重度の虚弱体質に加えて自己肯定感が極端に低く引っ込み思案の「よわよわ」なため、生徒からは奇行にしか見えない挙動を重ねたのが原因で「機嫌を損ねたら呪われる」と誤解を招き「こわこわ先生」と呼ばれて恐れられるようになった。
本人は「生徒から頼られる教師になりたい」と言う意識が強く、放課後に誰もいない教室でぬいぐるみを並べて授業のリハーサルを重ねていたが、その姿を見てクラス委員に志願した章人からサポートの申し出を受ける。
朝が弱く、定時登校に自信が無いため上司の薦めで高校の近くにあるアパートへ引っ越したが、入居した先は章人の隣の部屋だった。

阿比倉 章人（あびくら あきひと）
声 - 波多野翔
本作のもう1人の主人公。ひよりが初めて受け持ったクラスの生徒。高校2年生。16歳。穏やかな性格の平和主義者で、取り立てて目立つ存在ではなく、本人も平穏無事に「ほどほど」の高校生活を過ごしたいと考えていたが、担任になったひよりが他の生徒から誤解され続けている状況を捨て置けずにクラス委員を志願し、授業のリハーサルを手伝うようになった。ひよりを巻き込んでラッキースケベに遭遇することが多く、初期の頃は瑞希から軽蔑の目で見られることもあった。

椋林 瑞希（むくばやし みずき）
声 - 伊駒ゆりえ
章人と同じクラスの女子生徒で、同じ小学校の出身だが特に仲良しではなかった。ひよりほどではないにせよ巨乳。超高校生級の運動能力と高い社交性を兼備する陽キャで、ひよりからは自分と対極の「つよつよギャル」として羨望の眼差しを向けられている。小学生の頃から人間離れした怪力を持っており、度々物を破壊したり服を破いてしまう。章人がひよりに付き合って授業のリハーサルを手伝う場面に出くわし、クラス委員の交代を要求したが2人共同で委員をすることになった。

雪下 祐樹（ゆきした ゆうき）
声 - 篠原侑
章人の同級生。小柄な「ミニミニ」の体型をしており、ショートカットで一人称が「おれ」のため、ひよりの家庭訪問に同伴した章人との初対面では男子だと誤認されていたが女子生徒である。学校には行きたがらないが自分を気にかけて家庭訪問を続けるひよりに対しては好感を抱いており、隙あらば巨乳を揉みたがる。

九栗 香夜（くぐり かや）
声 - 夏吉ゆうこ
章人たちの学校の3年生。最近SNSで話題のフォトグラファー「KuguriN」の正体であり、彼女がアップする写真はものすごく「エモエモ」だという。
ひよりのエロス溢れる雰囲気に惚れこんで被写体になることを懇願、さらにひよりのエロスを引き出すには章人と一緒にいる必要があると考え、2人を自身が設立する予定の写真部に顧問と部員としてスカウトし、瑞希と祐樹も加わったことで部員が揃い、写真部を設立する。

阿比倉 朱美（あびくら あけみ）
声 - 中原麻衣
章人の姉。29歳で看護師をしており、ブラコンとして12歳下の弟を甘やかすことに生き甲斐を感じる「あまあまお姉ちゃん」。弟に自立心が芽生えて寂しいと感じていたところにマンションの隣室へひよりが引っ越して来て、弟と同じように庇護欲を掻き立てられる。

柄永 英里佳（えなが えりか）
章人たちの学校の2年1組の生徒。お嬢様口調で話す。
風紀委員をしており、何でも取り締まるうえに一度目を付けられるとしつこく、1年の時にゴシップ・でっちあげだらけだった新聞部を廃部に追い込んだという噂がある。しかし、写真部の過激なコスチュームを「芸術のためならばれっきとした活動」と容認するなど、話の分かる「ゆるゆる」な風紀委員だと思われた。
その正体は、女の子好きで大の男嫌いな「ゆりゆり」の風紀委員。ひよりが本当は不器用で優しく生徒想いだと気付いており、その容姿もあってひよりの大ファンだが、彼女と親しい章人のことは当初は「女の子の百合の園を汚す悪の手」と認識し、嫌っていたが、お互いにひよりに好意を持っていることを知ってからは態度を改め、嫌わなくなる。
それでも他の男は依然として苦手であり、男嫌いを治すためにたびたび章人を女装させている。

enwiki.title: Yowayowa Sensei
enwiki.text:
Yowayowa Sensei (よわよわ先生; lit. 'Weak-willed Teacher') is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Kamio Fukuchi. It began serialization in Kodansha's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in November 2022 and has been compiled into nineteen tankōbon volumes as of September 2026. An anime television series adaptation produced by Brain's Base aired from April to June 2026.


Plot
The series follows Akihito Abikura, a second-year high school student. His new homeroom teacher is Hiyori Hiwamura, an English teacher who recently graduated from university. Due to her shy personality, she does not make a good impression. Her use of a notebook full of sticky notes leads to rumors about her putting curses on the students, leading them to misunderstand her and refer to her as "Scary Teacher." Akihito realizes she is not scary at all, just misunderstood. After seeing her teach in an empty classroom with only a stuffed animal, he offers to help her overcome her shyness.


Characters
Akihito Abikura (阿比倉 章人, Abikura Akihito)
Voiced by: Kakeru Hatano (anime) (Japanese); Bryson Baugus (English)
A second-year high school student under Hiyori. He decides to help Hiyori with her shyness after seeing her teaching a mock class and realizing that she is not actually scary, merely misunderstood. He offers to become class representative as part of helping her out. He often finds himself in lewd situations with Hiyori.
Hiyori Hiwamura (鶸村 ひより, Hiwamura Hiyori)
Voiced by: Marika Kōno (PV, anime) (Japanese); Karlii Hoch (English)
An English teacher who just started her career after graduating from university. She becomes Akihito's homeroom teacher. Due to her extremely shy personality, students gain a negative perception of her, leading her to be nicknamed "Scary Teacher." She later moves next to Akihito's apartment to be closer to school. In order to gain confidence, she sometimes puts plush toys in a classroom and practices teaching with them.
Mizuki Mukubayashi (椋林 瑞希, Mukubayashi Mizuki)
Voiced by: Yurie Igoma (Japanese); Juliet Simmons (English)
Akihito's classmate who is a gyaru. Although the two went to the same elementary school, they are initially not close. However, she actually has had feelings for Akihito all this time. She later becomes co-class representative along with Akihito.
Akemi Abikura (阿比倉 朱美, Abikura Akemi)
Voiced by: Mai Nakahara (Japanese); Ellen Elise Evans (English)
Akihito's older sister who works as a nurse. She is very protective of Akihito.
Yuki Yukishita (雪下 祐樹, Yukishita Yūki)
Voiced by: Yū Sasahara (Japanese); Brittney Karbowski (English)
Akihito's classmate. She has a tomboyish personality and uses the masculine pronoun ore.
Kaya Kuguri (九栗 香夜, Kuguri Kaya)
Voiced by: Yūko Natsuyoshi (Japanese); Katelyn Barr (English)
A third-year student with an interest in photography. She is very attached to Hiyori.


Media


Manga
Written and illustrated by Kamio Fukuchi, Yowayowa Sensei began serialization in Kodansha's Weekly Shōnen Magazine on November 16, 2022. The series has been compiled into nineteen tankōbon volumes as of September 2026. To promote the release of the seventh volume, a promotional video was released on YouTube featuring Marika Kōno as the voice of Hiyori. A collaboration with cosplayer Enako featuring her cosplaying the character Mizuki was released in June 2024.


Anime
An anime television series adaptation was announced on December 4, 2024. It was produced by Brain's Base and directed by Hiroshi Ishiodori, with series composition handled by Yoshifumi Fukushima, characters designed by Naoki Aisaka, and music composed by Akifumi Tada and Rina Tayama. The series aired from April 11 to June 27, 2026, on AT-X and other channels. The opening theme song is "COMIT COMET" performed by Daoko, while the ending theme song is "Yowayowa Tsuyotsuyo Minimini Kowakowa" (わよわ つよつよ みにみに こわこわ) performed by Marika Kōno, Yurie Igoma and Yū Sasahara as their respective characters. 
Sentai Filmworks licensed the series in North America for streaming on Hidive. Medialink licensed the series for streaming on Ani-One Asia's YouTube channel. Hidive announced the series would receive an English dub, which premiered on June 24, 2026.

## Yowayowa Sensei
Yowayowa Sensei is anime 2026 in production by OLM
==Characters Cast==

*Hiyori Hiwamura - Misato Fukuen

*Akemi Abikura - Orie Kimoto
*Yūki Yukishita - Nana Mizuki
*Kaya Kuguri - Ai Fairouz

## Hiyori Hiwamura
Hiyori Hiwamura（鶸村 ひより）, widely known by the terrified student body as Kowakowa Sensei and by Akihito Abikura as the profoundly pathetic Yowayowa Sensei, is the primary heroine of Yowayowa Sensei. She is a rookie English teacher whose crippling social anxiety is completely misinterpreted by the school as malicious, dark-magic intimidation.

== Appearance ==
Hiyori is a young woman of petite stature, yet her voluptuous body is extremely busty. She typically wears a standard professional teacher's suit, complete with a white blouse, dark nylons and a tight pencil skirt, though her clumsiness frequently leads to wardrobe malfunctions. She has dark, shoulder-length hair (silver in anime) and always wears glasses. Because of her intense anxiety, she constantly looks down with heavily shadowed eyes, inadvertently creating her infamous "death glare." 

== Personality ==
The absolute core of Hiyori's character is a massive misunderstanding.  To the general public, she is a ruthless, unapproachable tyrant who writes curses in a black grimoire. In reality, she is a remarkably timid, fragile, and sweet 22-year-old who has zero physical stamina and cannot hold a basic conversation without a script.  

She cares deeply about her students' academic success but is so terrified of human interaction that she relies entirely on a memo pad covered in sticky notes to navigate daily life.  When confronted with unexpected situations—especially those involving her secret-keeper, Akihito Abikura—she easily short-circuits, resulting in tears, fainting, or frantic apologies. 

== Background ==
Freshly graduated from university, Hiyori secured a teaching position hoping to inspire students, but her social execution immediately tanked. During her first few weeks, her nervous muttering and frantic note-checking were misinterpreted by the student body as her casting hexes, cementing her reputation as the "Witch of the Faculty Room." Her life only began to change when Akihito Abikura accidentally walked in on her practicing a lesson in front of stuffed animals, shattering her intimidating facade forever.

== Trivia ==
* Her nickname "Yowayowa" (よわよわ) literally translates to "weak-weak," reflecting her absolute lack of fortitude.
* The "grimoire" students fear is actually just a desperate collection of conversational cheat sheets and teaching notes.
* She has the physical stamina of a wet paper towel and gets exhausted just carrying a stack of standard printouts.
* Her dynamic with Akihito heavily mirrors the operational reliance of a rally driver on their co-driver; she cannot navigate the classroom without his social pacenotes.

== References ==

## Akihito Abikura
Akihito Abikura（浴倉 秋人） is the primary male protagonist of Yowayowa Sensei. Operating as a second-year student and the Class Representative, he is the sole custodian of Hiyori Hiwamura's secret and acts as her dedicated crisis manager, shielding her crippling anxiety from the rest of the student body.

== Appearance ==
Akihito presents as a standard high school student with an athletic, average build. He has short, textured hair and is almost exclusively seen wearing the standard Fūrin High School male uniform. Because he is constantly managing high-stress situations involving his teacher and fending off aggressive fanservice variables from his classmates, his default expression is often deadpan, exhausted, or highly focused.

== Personality ==
Akihito is highly pragmatic, fiercely protective, and deeply observant. Unlike standard rom-com protagonists who suffer from chronic density, Akihito possesses a sharp situational awareness. He instantly reads the room and understands exactly when Hiyori is about to short-circuit.

He has a rigid moral compass. When he first realized how completely defenseless and pathetic Hiyori actually was, his protective instincts overrode his desire for a quiet school life. He is willing to sacrifice his own time, reputation, and mental energy to ensure she succeeds as an educator. While he is frequently ambushed by extreme ecchi scenarios, he maintains a tactical focus on damage control rather than giving in to the chaos.

== Role ==
Within the narrative framework, Akihito operates identically to a high-performance rally co-driver. Hiyori is completely incapable of navigating the social topography of the classroom without his real-time pacenotes.

* He actively misdirects student attention when Hiyori drops her notes or begins to panic.
* He deciphers her terrified muttering and amplifies it into coherent, authoritative instructions for the class.
* He acts as a defensive perimeter against rogue variables like Mizuki and Kaya, who actively attempt to disrupt Hiyori's fragile stability to elicit a reaction.

== Background ==
Akihito was living a standard, low-profile high school existence until a specific logistical failure changed his trajectory. He returned to an empty classroom to retrieve a forgotten item and accidentally witnessed the terrifying "Kowakowa Sensei" frantically practicing a mock lesson in front of stuffed animals. Realizing her fearsome reputation was a massive misunderstanding covering up severe social anxiety, he volunteered for the Class Representative position specifically to manage her daily operations.

== Gallery ==

== References ==

## Mizuki Mukubayashi
Mizuki Mukubayashi（椋林 みづき） is a major supporting character and romantic foil in Yowayowa Sensei. She serves as the Co-Class Representative alongside Akihito Abikura. Operating as the flagship gyaru of the series, she injects high-level extroversion and unpredictability into the classroom dynamic, frequently compromising Akihito's efforts to keep Hiyori Hiwamura's secret hidden.

== Appearance ==
Mizuki strictly adheres to modern gyaru aesthetics, completely contrasting with Hiyori's conservative and repressed visual design. She has brightly dyed hair, frequently styled with colorful accessories, and wears a highly customized, relaxed version of the Fūrin High School uniform. Her posture is inherently confident, and she uses physical proximity as a natural part of her communication style, which often triggers extreme panic in both Hiyori and Akihito.

== Personality ==
Mizuki is highly observant, socially dominant, and deeply extroverted. While she initially appears to be a standard, superficial high school girl, she possesses a sharp situational awareness that makes her incredibly dangerous to Akihito's operational security. 

She is not malicious, but she is highly inquisitive and easily bored. When she senses a vulnerability or a hidden dynamic—specifically the bizarre, codependent tension between her stoic co-representative and their supposedly terrifying teacher—she actively pokes at it for her own amusement. Despite her teasing nature, she is fundamentally good-hearted and highly capable of organizing the class when properly motivated.

== Tactical Role ==
Within the rom-com ecosystem, Mizuki functions as a pressure-testing mechanism and a primary instigator of fanservice scenarios. 

* **The Foil:** Her overwhelming confidence highlights Hiyori's complete lack thereof. When Mizuki takes control of a situation, it forces Hiyori to recognize her own inadequacies and push past her comfort zone.
* **The Proximity Catalyst:** Because she does not respect standard personal space boundaries, her interactions frequently force Akihito into compromising physical situations. She physically drags him away from his defensive perimeter around Hiyori, creating gaps that the narrative exploits for dramatic tension.
* **The Suspicion Engine:** She is one of the few characters who actively questions why the "Scary Teacher" allows Akihito to order her around, constantly threatening to deduce their actual dynamic.

== Background ==
Mizuki was appointed as the female Co-Class Representative simply because of her high social standing among the student body. She initially viewed the role as a chore, but her active engagement increased once she realized how intensely Akihito was managing the classroom's relationship with Hiyori.

## Akemi Abikura
Akemi Abikura（阿比倉 朱美） is a supporting character in Yowayowa Sensei. She is Akihito Abikura's older sister and works professionally as a nurse. Within the narrative, she functions as a highly aggressive defensive mechanism, fiercely guarding her brother from any perceived external threats—especially his new neighbor and homeroom teacher, Hiyori Hiwamura.

== Appearance ==
Akemi is a young adult woman with a mature, voluptuous figure  is extremely busty only slightly less than Hiyori.  When off duty at home, she usually dresses casually, but her presence commands immediate authority.  Her character design contrasts heavily with Hiyori's fragile demeanor, projecting confidence and a sharp, interrogative aura whenever she suspects someone is meddling with her brother.

== Personality ==
Akemi's defining psychological trait is her overwhelming "brother complex" (bro-con). She dotes heavily on Akihito, treating him with an intense, overprotective affection that frequently crosses into comedic territoriality. 

Despite her professional and grounded career as a nurse, her logic completely short-circuits whenever Akihito is involved with other women. She is highly suspicious, quick to jump to conclusions, and acts as an aggressive interrogator. When Hiyori Hiwamura moves into the apartment next door, Akemi instantly classifies the clumsy teacher as a high-level threat and monitors their interactions relentlessly.

== Tactical Role ==
In the overarching rom-com ecosystem, Akemi operates as a proximity hazard and an anti-progress variable.
* While Akihito manages Hiyori's crises at school, Akemi ensures that the domestic front (their apartment complex) is a high-stress environment.
* Her constant suspicion forces Akihito and Hiyori to hide their strategic alliance, ironically resulting in closer, more compromising physical situations as they try to avoid her detection.

== Background ==
Akemi currently lives with Akihito and serves as his primary guardian and financial anchor while working in the medical field. Her daily routine involves managing her intense hospital shifts while simultaneously running domestic surveillance on her brother's social life.
